Skratch Hydration Sport Drink Mix was created to replace the electrolytes lost in sweat and to provide a little bit of energy when working out, without offending your palate or gut. We reimagined sports drinks, stripping ours down to the bare essentials to safely hydrate and quench thirst, so that athletes feel and perform better.

Great for:

  • Preload
  • During activity
  • When thirsty

Add one scoop to 12 to 16 fl oz (350 to 500 ml) of water and shake. As a starting point, drink 1-2 servings for each hour of exercise, but also mind your thirst.

Use when sweating, drink when thirsty. Don’t drink when not thirsty.

INGREDIENTS: Cane Sugar, Sodium Citrate, Dextrose, Mango Powder, Citric Acid, Calcium Citrate, Magnesium Carbonate, Potassium Citrate, Ascorbic Acid.
Dairy-free. Gluten-free. Nut-free. Kosher. Vegan. Non-GMO.

the right electrolyte profile

Sodium makes up ~90% of the electrolytes lost in sweat. Our hydration mixes match average sweat loss with 400 mg sodium plus potassium, calcium, and magnesium, so it’s easier to stay hydrated.

carbs that do more than fuel

19–20g of simple carbs (glucose + fructose) per serving to support rapid hydration, maintain blood sugar, and keep your energy steady—so you can go hard without bonking.

real fruit. no flavor fatigue.

Flavored only with real fruit for light taste—no artificial sweeteners or colors. That means no gut issues or flavor fatigue. Just hydration you’ll actually want to drink.

performance you can trust

The original Skratch mix—developed on the pro cycling tour for athletes who needed something better. Still used by the pros. Still our go-to.

low osmolality. no GI distress.

Lower osmolality means faster fluid absorption and less risk of GI distress. Our hydration helps your body retain and use fluid efficiently—so you stay hydrated without discomfort.

frequently asked questions

Electrolytes are minerals, like sodium, potassium, calcium, and magnesium, that help your body hold onto fluid, maintain proper muscle function, and keep your nervous system firing. When you sweat, you lose more than just water, you also lose electrolytes, especially sodium. If you don’t replace both, your performance can suffer. Replacing them helps you stay hydrated and perform better, longer.

Our electrolyte profile was developed to match what is in sweat - 400 mg sodium/L, 80 mg potassium/L, 100 mg calcium/L, 80 mg magnesium/L. We include the average amount of electrolytes lost in sweat, especially sodium, so your hydration reflects what your body actually needs. That balance helps your body absorb water faster and makes thirst a better guide during exercise.

A small amount of sugar helps your body absorb fluid faster through something called sodium-glucose co-transport - this helps water and electrolytes move from your gut into your bloodstream more quickly. It also gives you a steady source of energy. We use just enough to help you perform, not so much that it overwhelms your gut or your taste buds.

That depends on how much you sweat and how hard you’re going. A good starting point is one serving per hour of activity, but some athletes need more—especially in heat or humidity. Listen to your thirst, monitor your energy, and adjust as needed.

Light and refreshing, with real fruit flavor that doesn’t wear out your palate. It’s not overly sweet or artificial tasting so you can actually enjoy it for hours into your long ride or run.

Nope—and that’s THE reason we made it. We use real ingredients your body knows how to digest, and we cut out the functionless ingredients like artificial sweeteners, flavorings and dyes that can cause GI distress. We use only real fruit for superior taste. So it's hydration that feels as good as it tastes.

Definitely. Hydration Sport Drink Mix is great on its own, but it’s also designed to be part of your broader fueling system. Add our Electrolyte Booster for more sodium when it’s extra hot or sweaty, or pair with High Carb Drink Mix or chews when you need more calories and carbs.

We use real fruit for flavor—no emulsifiers or stabilizers—so some settling is normal. Just give your bottle a quick shake before each sip and you’re good to go. We think it’s worth it for flavor that’s real, not fake.
